arxiv-2101-00520.title: Axion-Like Particles at the ILC Giga-Z
arxiv-2101-00520.creator: Noah Steinberg, James D. Wells
arxiv-2101-00520.description: Abstract August 8, 2026 Abstract: Axion-Like Particles (ALPs) are a generic, calculable, and well motivated extension of the Standard Model with far reaching phenomenology. ALPs that couple only to hypercharge represent one subset of such models, coupling the ALP to both photons and the Z boson.

arxiv-2203-04068.title: Finding nontrivial zeros of quadratic forms over rational function fields of characteristic 2
arxiv-2203-04068.creator: Tímea Csahók, Péter Kutas, Mickaël Montessinos, Gergely Zábrádi
arxiv-2203-04068.description: Abstract We propose polynomial-time algorithms for finding nontrivial zeros of quadratic forms with four variables over rational function fields of characteristic 2. We apply these results to find prescribed quadratic subfields of quaternion division division algebras and zero divisors in M 2 ​ ( D ) M_{2}(D) , the full matrix algebra over a division algebra, given by structure constants.

arxiv-2303-06676.title: Local Search For SMT On Linear and Multi-linear Real Arithmetic
arxiv-2303-06676.creator: Bohan Li \orcid 0000-0003-1356-6057, Shaowei Cai \orcid 0000-0003-1730-6922 1
arxiv-2303-06676.description: Abstract Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) has significant application in various domains. In this paper, we focus on quantifier-free Satisfiablity Modulo Real Arithmetic, referred to as SMT(RA), including both linear and non-linear real arithmetic theories. As for non-linear real arithmetic theory, we focus on one of its important fragments where the atomic constraints are multi-linear.

arxiv-2310-08681.title: Fed-Safe: Securing Federated Learning in Healthcare Against Adversarial Attacks
arxiv-2310-08681.creator: Erfan Darzi, Nanna M. Sijtsema, P.M.A van Ooijen
arxiv-2310-08681.description: Abstract This paper explores the security aspects of federated learning applications in medical image analysis. Current robustness-oriented methods like adversarial training, secure aggregation, and homomorphic encryption often risk privacy compromises. The central aim is to defend the network against potential privacy breaches while maintaining model robustness against adversarial manipulations.

arxiv-2411-02227.title: Optimization Models to Meet the Conditions of Order Preservation in the Analytic Hierarchy Process
arxiv-2411-02227.creator: Jiancheng Tu, Wu Zhibin, Yueyuan LI, Chuankai XIang
arxiv-2411-02227.description: Abstract Deriving a priority vector from a pairwise comparison matrix (PCM) is a crucial step in the Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP). Although there exists a priority vector that satisfies the conditions of order preservation (COP), the priority vectors obtained through existing prioritization methods frequently violate these conditions, resulting in numerous COP violations.

pmc-10547801.title: Treatment of infected predators under the influence of fear-induced refuge
pmc-10547801.creator: Bapin Mondal, Abhijit Sarkar, Nazmul Sk
pmc-10547801.description: In this research, we delve into the dynamics of an infected predator–prey system in the presence of fear and refuge, presenting a novel inclusion of treatment for infected individuals in this type of model. Through our analytical efforts, we establish a significant reproduction number that holds a pivotal role in determining disease extinction or persistence within the system.

pmc-10713114.title: PICAFlow: a complete R workflow dedicated to flow/mass cytometry data, from pre-processing to deep and comprehensive analysis
pmc-10713114.creator: Paul Régnier, Cindy Marques, David Saadoun, Lina Ma
pmc-10713114.description: Summary PICAFlow is a R-written integrative workflow dedicated to flow/mass cytometry data handling, from pre-processing to deep and comprehensive analysis. It is designed as a powerful all-in-one tool which contains all the necessary functions and packages presented in a user-friendly and ease-to-use fashion.

pmc-11348223.title: Canonical and Non-Canonical Wnt Signaling Generates Molecular and Cellular Asymmetries to Establish Embryonic Axes
pmc-11348223.creator: De-Li Shi, Junichi Iwata, Christopher A Johnston
pmc-11348223.description: The formation of embryonic axes is a critical step during animal development, which contributes to establishing the basic body plan in each particular organism. Wnt signaling pathways play pivotal roles in this fundamental process. Canonical Wnt signaling that is dependent on β-catenin regulates the patterning of dorsoventral, anteroposterior, and left–right axes.

pmc-12428168.title: Workforce Allocation in Urban Community Mental Health Services: GIS-Based Analytical Insights for Policy and Planning
pmc-12428168.creator: Somayyeh Azimi, Nasir Uddin, Yongwan Chun, Daniel A Griffith, Amy E Hughes
pmc-12428168.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: This study aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the current mental health workforce and the factors influencing its distribution within adult community mental health services in Western Australia’s North Metropolitan Health Service. Methods: Mental health workforce supply across North Metropolitan Statistical Area Level 2 (SA2-Australian Statistical Geography Standard) was estimated using the Geographically-adjusted Index of Relative Supply (GIRS) and categorised as low (0–3) or moderate-to-high (4–8) for analysis and testing associations with multiple covariates.

pmc-12767458.title: Dimensionality of the Spanish Version of the Universal Mental Health Literacy Scale Among Colombian Adults
pmc-12767458.creator: Adalberto Campo-Arias, Edwin Herazo, Jorge Mario Ortega-Iglesias
pmc-12767458.description: The Universal Mental Health Literacy Scale for Adolescents (UMHL‐A) is a new 17‐item tool designed to assess adolescents’ mental health attitudes and knowledge. This scale can also be adapted for adults and is known as the UMHL. This study evaluated the dimensionality of the UMHL among Colombian adult high school students.

pmc-13238661.title: Platform‐Specific Learning Curves in Robotic‐Assisted Total Knee Arthroplasty: A Systematic Review
pmc-13238661.creator: Ryhan Divyang Patel, Praneshraja Ganesaraja, Kapil Sugand, Sree Kanakala, Indi Gupte, Srikar Reddy Namireddy, Saran Singh Gill
pmc-13238661.description: Robotic‐assisted total knee arthroplasty (raTKA) has seen widespread adoption due to its potential to enhance surgical precision and implant alignment. However, learning curves (LCs) for different robotic platforms remain poorly characterized, complicating training and safe implementation. This systematic review quantified the LC across major raTKA systems, focusing on operative time and the number of cases required to achieve procedural proficiency.

pmc-13297161.title: Characterization of PR-Cre Activity in the Testis and Its Application Reveals BRG1 Is Dispensable in Adult Leydig Cells
pmc-13297161.creator: Hongbiao Shi, Yilin Du, Yu Liang, Ai Liu, Congzhe Hou, Xi Li, Jiangxia Li, Wenjie Sun, Yecheng Jin, Qiji Liu
pmc-13297161.description: Leydig cells play a crucial role in male development, fertility, and overall health through hormone production. Brahma-related gene 1 (BRG1), the catalytic subunit of the mammalian SWI/SNF complex, is a key regulator of chromatin accessibility and governs the development and function of diverse tissues. However, its role in Leydig cells remains unclear.
